prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1467; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was struck on the driver side by a third-party vehicle that entered on a red signal. Police report requested. Claimant reports minor knee pain at scene, declined ambulance transport.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant confirmed no attorney retained and prefers to handle the claim directly. Claimant describes persistent knee pain after impact, worse when bending or climbing stairs. Advised claimant to keep records of all medical visits, prescriptions, and out-of-pocket costs.

Entry 3: Recorded statement obtained from claimant. Claimant states the other driver admitted to looking at a phone before the impact. Two independent witness contacts noted on file. Claimant has scheduled an appointment with a primary care physician for further evaluation of the knee.

Entry 4: Received medical documentation from claimant's provider. Diagnosis indicates a knee sprain with possible meniscus involvement pending imaging. Reviewed coverage limits on the third-party policy and noted liability is not yet accepted. Requested the MRI report and the physician's work restriction notes.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. Claimant is still unrepresented and asked general questions about how a settlement is calculated. Explained the process in general terms and recommended consulting an attorney if claimant has questions about rights. Diary set for review once imaging results are received.
